key.summary: Battery bar text color

key.summary: Show the battery percentage (bold) next to the left section of the top bar

key.summary: Below this percentage the low color is used

key.summary: Below this percentage (and above low) the mid color is used

key.summary: Battery bar color when low

key.summary: Play the battery bar when the laptop battery crosses the alert levels (event-driven, no polling)

key.summary: Battery bar color when medium (above medium, the charger or Bluetooth color is used)

key.summary: Where the trigger button sits and its menu opens ('key' is the legacy hidden value, read as hidden + center)

key.summary: Hide the trigger button; the shortcut opens its menu at the chosen position

key.name: trigger-button-icon
key.summary: Icon name (or absolute file path) for the trigger button

key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens the trigger menu

key.summary: Show each script's icon in the menu

key.summary: Show each script's name in the menu

key.summary: Show a run arrow on each script in the menu

key.summary: Menu clock, large top line (GLib.DateTime format; empty hides it)

key.summary: Menu clock, smaller second line (GLib.DateTime format; empty hides it)

key.summary: Maximum width of the output text in px

key.name: output-label-font
key.summary: Output label font family

key.name: output-label-font-size
key.summary: Output label font size in pixels

key.name: output-label-bold
key.summary: Use bold output label

key.summary: Show the preview text instead of running scripts

key.summary: Text shown while previewing the output
